issue.title: Directory: geekflare/geekflare-skills (Geekflare web data and website checks)
issue.body:
### Request

Add my skills

### Public GitHub repository

https://github.com/geekflare/geekflare-skills

### Skill names or listing scope

geekflare

### Details

Suggested category: Developer Tools and Frameworks (developer-tools). Data, Analytics and Databases (data-databases) would also fit.

Geekflare (https://geekflare.com/api) is a web data API. This skill teaches an agent when and how to use it, through the official Geekflare MCP server or the REST API. It covers:
- live web search, including the full Google results page by country or city
- turning public pages into Markdown or JSON
- page metadata, and brand data (logos, colors, fonts) for a domain
- screenshots and URL-to-PDF
- website checks: uptime, DNS, TLS, redirects, broken links, load time and Lighthouse

It works with public pages only. It doesn't bypass logins, paywalls, CAPTCHAs or bot protection.
- Hosted MCP server: https://mcp.geekflare.com/mcp
- MCP documentation: https://docs.geekflare.com/mcp/overview
- MCP Registry name: com.geekflare/mcp
- Authentication: a Geekflare API key in GEEKFLARE_API_KEY. A free tier is available.
- License: MIT

### Confirmation

- [x] I maintain this repository, or I am requesting a listing for a public repository on its maintainers' behalf.
